title: Telluride Historical Museum

services.name: Historic Walking Tour
services.desc: An event every week that begins at 1:00 PM on Tuesday and Thursday, repeating until October 22, 2026 Join us for a one-of-a-kind experience exploring the history of Telluride with local storytellers! Learn more about the people, the history, and the architecture that make Telluride so special. Walking Tours start at the Museum every Tuesday and Thursday at 1pm during the summer and fall seasons. Advance reservations are not required. Tour price of $15/person ($10 for Museum members) includes Museum admission. We advise arriving to the Museum by 12:45pm at the latest.
